items.text: Its legislators passed, as the only group voting for it, a budget amendment raising the tax on companies' purchases of their own shares from 8 to 33 percent and extending it to more companies.

Proposed replacing the tax on property wealth with a tax on financial wealth that excludes business assets, small-company shares, and middle-class housing, and opposed raising the tax rate on investment income.
